briefdescription.para: Passive shard without active coordination lease.
Runtime role of this node in distributed coordination.
Task execution callback for coordinated tasks.
Callback invoked when a leader is elected or changed.

LOCK ORDERING (CANONICAL): Tier 1: leader_mutex_ — manages leader role, term, lease state ↓ cannot acquire Tier 2 or Tier 3 while holding this lock Tier 2: tasks_mutex_ — manages pending task queue ↓ cannot acquire Tier 3 while holding this lock Tier 3: callback_mutex_ — manages registered callbacks ↓ terminal tier; can only release when exiting.

detaileddescription.para: RATIONALE: Prevent cyclic dependencies and ensure fair ordering under contention. All acquisitions must follow this hierarchy to avoid deadlock. Known current leader shard ID.
